bio: Hello! I'm Ryujin, a second-year master's student in the [Department of Computer and Mathematical Sciences](https://www.is.tohoku.ac.jp/en/laboratory/list_dept/) at [Tohoku University's Graduate School of Information Sciences](https://www.is.tohoku.ac.jp/en/). I work in the [Foundations of Software Science](https://www.is.tohoku.ac.jp/en/laboratory/list_dept/a11.html) group under the supervision of [Professor Eijiro Sumii](https://www.kb.ecei.tohoku.ac.jp/~sumii/).

My research is in programming language theory. With guidance from [Oleg Kiselyov](https://okmij.org/ftp/), I'm studying how algebraic descriptions of probabilistic models can be used in multi-stage programming.
I'm also interested in modal and categorical logic, and in what formal constructions might elucidate.
I suppose keeping a diary and noticing birds and “bugs” on my walks count as hobbies. :-)
